titan.migrateFeel: Slow, uneven lumber. Preserve individual pauses and direction changes. Invade Maria only after a breach, through an explicit open gate waypoint; never shortcut across an intact wall.
titan.notes: Bob is in app units after displayScale. Sway pivots at the feet. walkFps counts frame changes per second; one gait cycle is two changes. Translate the fixed-head sprite for a heavy head bob. Preserve phase on turns; mirror only when horizontal speed exceeds 0.15 units/s.

civilian.migrateFeel: Quick, short steps in loose household clusters. Retreat through gate waypoints from Maria to Rose to Sina when the scene permits. Fleeing: 8 frame changes/s and 8.5 app units/s; stagger departures and retain small pauses at gates.
civilian.notes: Larger civilian scale retains pairs, bundles and cart silhouettes on a full-island phone view. Idle holds frame a. No wall crossing during ambient wandering. Preserve head and torso coordinates between frames. Render populations below routes and portrait markers.
